title: TAPP Composition Module: LaserAblation
description:
The shared LaserAblation block of the 2026-08-11 TAPP library (Claude Skills for TAPP/Module_LaserAblation.csv), composed by 6 of the sixteen delivery tables. 29 owned fields over 22 schema paths.

GENERATED by tools/build_module_bb.py from the module's CSV and its schema-path sidecar — edit those, not this file. Requiredness follows the TAPP tier matrix: a field Basic on a side is required there, Advanced is permitted, N/A is absent from that side entirely.

This is a PROFILE, not a vocabulary: it asserts which properties a conforming procedure or analysis carries. Column F (Example / Allowed Content) is consumer-owned per the module manifest, so no enum is pinned here — a consuming TAPP may narrow a value space, never widen it.

ProcedureIdentification.title: LaserAblation on the procedure
ProcedureIdentification.description: Composed into a TAPP (prov:Plan) schema: what the procedure asserts once, for every analysis that follows it.

schema:name.description: Manufacturer and model of the laser ablation system.

ada:laserType.description: Wavelength and type of the laser used for ablation in nanometres.

schema:name.description: Type, design origin, and internal volume of the ablation cell.

ada:laserSpotGeometryDefault.description: Shape and dimensions of the laser ablation spot in micrometres registered by the procedure. For circular spots, report diameter; for square or rectangular spots, report width × length.

ada:laserFluenceDefault.description: Laser pulse energy per unit area at the sample surface in J cm⁻², as registered by the procedure. If the system reports only as % of maximum output, include that value and note the system maximum where known.

ada:laserRepetitionRateDefault.description: Laser pulse repetition rate in hertz registered by the procedure.

items.description: Sampling mode or ablation pattern used during analysis.

ada:ablationSpotDurationDefault.description: Total on-sample ablation (signal acquisition) time per individual spot in seconds, as set in the acquisition method. For transect analysis, the equivalent procedure-level parameter is scan speed (captured in Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size). For mapping analysis, total acquisition time is sample-area-dependent and is not captured here.

ada:ablationPitDepthRateDefault.description: Depth of the ablation pit produced under the registered laser conditions, the method used to measure it, and the resulting per-pulse ablation rate. For transect and mapping the equivalent quantity is trench depth under the same conditions.

ada:rasterLineSpacingDefault.description: Distance between adjacent raster lines in a 2D elemental map, measured perpendicular to the scan direction, in micrometres. Applies to raster mapping only.

ada:internalStandardApproach.description: Method used to determine the internal standard (IS) concentration for each unknown sample.

ada:sampleIntroduction.description: Configuration by which the ablated aerosol is delivered to the plasma, including tubing, any signal-homogenising device, and any co-aspirated solution introduced alongside the aerosol — for example a Tl solution used for instrumental mass bias correction, or an isotopic spike used for isotope dilution. Distinct from the carrier and make-up gas fields, which record gas identity and flow rather than what else enters the plasma.

ada:backgroundCountTimeDefault.description: Total time spent measuring gas blank (background signal with laser off or shutter closed) before each ablation event, in seconds. For spot and transect analysis, a discrete background interval is measured before each ablation. For mapping, background is typically measured once per raster line or at the start of a map session rather than before each individual pixel.

ada:carrierGasFlowRateDefault.description: Gas used to transport ablated aerosol from the ablation cell to the ICP-MS torch, with the procedure-registered target flow rate(s). Adjustment during tuning stays within ±10% of the target.

items.description: Method used to correct for laser-induced elemental fractionation (LIEF), including downhole fractionation during prolonged ablation, matrix-dependent fractionation between sample and calibration standard, and any specific correction algorithm applied. Reference the software function or publication.

Param_Analysis_preAblationSurfaceTreatme.title: Pre Ablation Surface Treatment
Param_Analysis_preAblationSurfaceTreatme.description: Procedure applied immediately before each analysis to remove surface contamination or condition the sample surface. Distinct from general sample preparation. For spot analysis, pre-ablation pulses are discarded before signal acquisition begins. For mapping, this step is typically omitted.

Param_Procedure_preAblationSurfaceTreatm.title: Pre Ablation Surface Treatment
Param_Procedure_preAblationSurfaceTreatm.description: Procedure applied immediately before each analysis to remove surface contamination or condition the sample surface. Distinct from general sample preparation. For spot analysis, pre-ablation pulses are discarded before signal acquisition begins. For mapping, this step is typically omitted.

Param_Analysis_laserEnergy.title: Laser Energy
Param_Analysis_laserEnergy.description: Laser pulse energy in millijoules as set at the laser output or measured at the sample surface. Report only when the system displays energy directly. Laser fluence (J cm⁻²) is the preferred quantity and is captured in Laser Fluence (Energy Density).

Param_Procedure_laserEnergy.title: Laser Energy
Param_Procedure_laserEnergy.description: Laser pulse energy in millijoules as set at the laser output or measured at the sample surface. Report only when the system displays energy directly. Laser fluence (J cm⁻²) is the preferred quantity and is captured in Laser Fluence (Energy Density).

Param_Procedure_laserBeamEnergyProfile.title: Laser Beam Energy Profile
Param_Procedure_laserBeamEnergyProfile.description: Spatial energy distribution of the laser beam at the sample surface, and whether a beam homogenizer is installed.

Param_Procedure_laserPulseDuration.title: Laser Pulse Duration
Param_Procedure_laserPulseDuration.description: Duration of each individual laser pulse, including units.

Param_Analysis_transectRateMappingRateOr.title: Transect Rate Mapping Rate or Step Size
Param_Analysis_transectRateMappingRateOr.description: For continuous line scan (transect) and raster mapping: the stage translation speed in µm s⁻¹. For mapping, the mapping rate (mm² h⁻¹) may be reported as an alternative when scan speed is session-variable. For stepped line profiles: the distance between successive spot positions in µm.

schema:name.const: Transect Rate Mapping Rate or Step Size

Param_Procedure_transectRateMappingRateO.title: Transect Rate Mapping Rate or Step Size
Param_Procedure_transectRateMappingRateO.description: For continuous line scan (transect) and raster mapping: the stage translation speed in µm s⁻¹. For mapping, the mapping rate (mm² h⁻¹) may be reported as an alternative when scan speed is session-variable. For stepped line profiles: the distance between successive spot positions in µm.

schema:name.const: Transect Rate Mapping Rate or Step Size

Param_Analysis_transectLength.title: Transect Length
Param_Analysis_transectLength.description: Total length of the transect line analysed in micrometres. Scan speed is captured separately in Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size.

Param_Analysis_mappedAreaDescription.title: Mapped area description
Param_Analysis_mappedAreaDescription.description: Location of the analysis on the sample surface. For spot and transect analysis: stage coordinates (X, Y in µm) or a description relative to a named reference feature (e.g., mineral rim, inclusion boundary). For mapping: coordinates of the map corner(s) or centre, plus map dimensions.

Param_Analysis_fusionFluxAndDilutionRati.title: Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio
Param_Analysis_fusionFluxAndDilutionRati.description: For procedures using fused glass, the flux type and sample:flux dilution ratio used to prepare the analytical glass.

Param_Procedure_fusionFluxAndDilutionRat.title: Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio
Param_Procedure_fusionFluxAndDilutionRat.description: For procedures using fused glass, the flux type and sample:flux dilution ratio used to prepare the analytical glass.

Param_Analysis_sampleFormAnalyticalSubst.title: Sample Form Analytical Substrate
Param_Analysis_sampleFormAnalyticalSubst.description: Physical form of the material as it enters the ablation cell. Variations that do not alter the analytical procedure (e.g., thin section vs. mount) are legitimate.

Param_Procedure_sampleFormAnalyticalSubs.title: Sample Form Analytical Substrate
Param_Procedure_sampleFormAnalyticalSubs.description: Physical form of the material as it enters the ablation cell. Variations that do not alter the analytical procedure (e.g., thin section vs. mount) are legitimate.

Param_Analysis_backgroundCountTime.title: Background Count Time
Param_Analysis_backgroundCountTime.description: Total time spent measuring gas blank (background signal with laser off or shutter closed) before each ablation event, in seconds. For spot and transect analysis, a discrete background interval is measured before each ablation. For mapping, background is typically measured once per raster line or at the start of a map session rather than before each individual pixel.

Param_Analysis_carrierGasAndFlowRate.title: Carrier Gas and Flow Rate
Param_Analysis_carrierGasAndFlowRate.description: Gas used to transport ablated aerosol from the ablation cell to the ICP-MS torch, with the procedure-registered target flow rate(s). Adjustment during tuning stays within ±10% of the target.

Param_Analysis_mappingArea.title: Mapping Area
Param_Analysis_mappingArea.description: Total area covered by the 2D raster map, expressed as width × height in µm or as total area in µm² or mm². Scan speed, line spacing and spot size are fixed by the procedure; the map area covers the target feature.

Param_Procedure_multiRunSequentialAnalys.title: Multi Run Sequential Analysis Design
Param_Procedure_multiRunSequentialAnalys.description: Whether the procedure uses a single acquisition pass or multiple sequential runs on the same sample location, each optimized for different analytical objectives. For multi-run designs, describe the number of runs, their purpose, key laser and instrument settings per run, and how outputs of one run feed into data reduction of another. Not applicable to raster mapping, where each spatial location is visited exactly once.

Param_Analysis_signalSmoothing.title: Signal Smoothing
Param_Analysis_signalSmoothing.description: Description of any signal smoothing device or approach installed between the ablation cell and the ICP-MS to reduce pulse-to-pulse signal variability. For mapping analyses, report "None" explicitly.

Param_Procedure_signalSmoothing.title: Signal Smoothing
Param_Procedure_signalSmoothing.description: Description of any signal smoothing device or approach installed between the ablation cell and the ICP-MS to reduce pulse-to-pulse signal variability. For mapping analyses, report "None" explicitly.

Param_Procedure_matrixOffsetCorrectionLi.title: Matrix Offset Correction LIEF
Param_Procedure_matrixOffsetCorrectionLi.description: Whether an empirical correction was applied to account for systematic differences in laser-induced elemental fractionation (LIEF) patterns between the external calibration standard and the sample matrix.
